blurb: Great Bay Marine is New Hampshire Seacoast’s only year-round, full-service boating facility. They provide boat servicing including power, electrics, plumbing, rigging, fiberglass, hauling, bottom painting, shrink-wrapping, maintenance, repairs, storage, engine re-powering, commissioning, and winterization. Located six miles up the Piscataqua River, they serve Rockingham county and surrounding areas.
